response.sql: SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY t.ordertypedist

assumptions.assumption: "High similarity" means patsim >= 0.439 (cutoff inclusive); records with NULL patsim are excluded.

Count is of matched (advancedbehavior, transactionrecord) pairs; since transreg is the primary key, each advanced behaviour record matches at most one transaction, so this equals the number of matched advanced behaviour records.
NULL ordertypedist forms its own group (GROUP BY places NULLs together, shown as NULL).

alternatives.interpretation: High similarity means strictly greater than the cutoff (patsim > 0.439).
